name: dos-kernel
description: Deterministic trust kernel for AI-agent fleets: verify an agent's "done" claim against git evidence instead of self-report, arbitrate file collisions between concurrent agents, and audit commit messages against their own diffs.

python.description: Run the dos-mcp stdio server from PyPI via uvx (the [mcp] extra carries the MCP server framework)

examples.title: Verify a 'done' claim
examples.description: Check whether claimed work actually landed, from git evidence rather than the agent's say-so
examples.prompt: Use dos_verify to check whether the phase I just claimed finished actually shipped in this repo

examples.title: Arbitrate concurrent edits
examples.description: Decide whether two agents may safely work the same files at the same time
examples.prompt: Use dos_arbitrate to check whether I can take the docs lane right now

examples.title: Audit a commit's claim
examples.description: Flag a commit whose message claims work its own diff doesn't contain
examples.prompt: Run dos_commit_audit on HEAD and tell me if the subject is backed by the diff
